units.input_readiness_he: לפני הטקסט בודקים מה המשתמש כבר מבין. תמיכות חדשות נחלקות לחבילות של עד 6 לפני המפגש או לטקסט קצר יותר. אין להניח שמילת תמיכה כבר ידועה, ואין לדחוס את כל רשימת הגלוסות לדקות המורה. זו קריאה מונחית; קריאה עצמאית דורשת בדיקת כיסוי אישית.
units.prerequisite_he: מיומנות תקשורת מן היחידה הקודמת, או מיון שמראה יכולת מקבילה. קריאה נבדקת בנפרד; אין חסימת שיחה בגלל פענוח.

units.goal_he: הכן הצעה לפעילות לקבוצה בדויה: שלוש אפשרויות, שלוש דרישות והמלצה. המורה יקשה בשתי שאלות חדשות. השב בלי לקרוא את הדגם.
units.grammar_he: integrated B1; coherent narrative and reasons

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Which activity do you recommend for the new colleagues?
dialogue.text_he: על איזו פעילות תמליץ לעמיתים החדשים?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: I recommend an indoor game evening because it is affordable and does not depend on the weather.
dialogue.text_he: אני ממליץ על ערב משחקים בתוך מבנה, כי הוא עומד בתקציב ואינו תלוי במזג האוויר.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Why not the cooking workshop or the guided walk?
dialogue.text_he: למה לא סדנת הבישול או הסיור המודרך?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: The workshop costs too much, while bad weather could make the walk difficult.
dialogue.text_he: הסדנה יקרה מדי, ואילו מזג אוויר גרוע עלול להקשות על הסיור.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Some newcomers may dislike complicated games. How will you include them?
dialogue.text_he: חלק מהמשתתפים החדשים עלולים לא לאהוב משחקים מורכבים. איך תשלבו אותם?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: We will use simple cooperative games and offer a quiet area for conversation.
dialogue.text_he: נשתמש במשחקים שיתופיים פשוטים ונציע אזור שקט לשיחה.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What if people arrive without knowing anyone or understanding the activity?
dialogue.text_he: מה אם אנשים יגיעו בלי להכיר איש או להבין את הפעילות?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Hosts will introduce people and explain the choices. We will also send a short description beforehand.
dialogue.text_he: המארחים יציגו אנשים זה לזה ויסבירו את האפשרויות. נשלח גם תיאור קצר מראש.

units.passage_en: A small team had to choose an activity for a group of new colleagues. The activity needed to be affordable, accessible by public transport and suitable for people who did not know one another well. The team compared a cooking workshop, a guided walk and a board-game evening. The workshop included food but cost more than the budget allowed. The walk was inexpensive, although bad weather could make it difficult. The board-game evening was indoors and affordable, but some participants might feel uncomfortable with complicated rules. The team recommended the game evening with simple cooperative games and a short explanation at the start. It also offered a quiet area where people could talk without playing. During the presentation, another colleague asked how newcomers would be included. The team explained that hosts would introduce people and change groups during the evening. The proposal was accepted with one change: participants would receive a short description beforehand so they could decide how they wanted to take part.

passage_questions.question_en: What three requirements did the activity need to meet?
passage_questions.answer_en: Affordable, reachable by public transport and suitable for unfamiliar colleagues.

passage_questions.question_en: Why was the cooking workshop rejected?
passage_questions.answer_en: It exceeded the budget.

passage_questions.question_en: What could make the walk difficult?
passage_questions.answer_en: Bad weather.

passage_questions.question_he: איך הקלו על מי שאינו רוצה לשחק?
passage_questions.question_en: What option was offered to people who preferred not to play?
passage_questions.answer_en: A quiet conversation area.

passage_questions.question_en: What change was requested after the presentation?
passage_questions.answer_en: A short description for participants beforehand.

passage_questions.question_en: What makes the recommendation more than a personal preference?
passage_questions.answer_en: It compares alternatives against stated requirements and responds to concerns.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: הכן הצעה לפעילות לקבוצה בדויה: שלוש אפשרויות, שלוש דרישות והמלצה. המורה יקשה בשתי שאלות חדשות. השב בלי לקרוא את הדגם.
units.model_response_en: I recommend an indoor game evening because it meets our budget and does not depend on the weather. We should choose simple cooperative games and offer a quiet area for conversation. Hosts can welcome newcomers and explain the choices before the event.
units.writing_prompt_he: כתוב הצעה של 150–180 מילים. כלול דרישות, השוואה, המלצה, מגבלה ותגובה לחשש אפשרי. לאחר משוב ערוך גרסה שנייה.

language_focus.rule_he: בהמלצה מנומקת אפשר להתחיל ב־I recommend ואחריו שם הפעילות. because מציג סיבה התומכת בבחירה, ואילו although מציג חיסרון או הסתייגות שאינם מבטלים אותה. כך אפשר להראות שבחנתם מחיר, מזג אוויר והעדפות שונות. אחרי recommend אין להשתמש ב־to לפני שם פעולה עם ing; אפשר לומר I recommend choosing.
language_focus.example_en: I recommend a game evening because it is affordable.
language_focus.contrast_en: Although some people dislike games, they can use the quiet conversation area. / I recommend choosing simple games.
language_focus.prompt_he: המליצו על ערב משחקים והסבירו שהוא אינו תלוי במזג האוויר.
language_focus.answer_en: I recommend a game evening because it does not depend on the weather.
language_focus.feedback_he: נכון: ההמלצה מציינת אפשרות מסוימת ו־because מחבר אותה לסיבה. בהמשך אפשר להכיר בחיסרון עם although ולהציג מענה מעשי.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What change would help you manage your workload?
dialogue.text_he: איזה שינוי יעזור לך לנהל את עומס העבודה?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: I would like to start earlier and leave at four.
dialogue.text_he: הייתי רוצה להתחיל מוקדם יותר ולצאת בארבע.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: We need some overlap with the support team.
dialogue.text_he: אנחנו צריכים חפיפה מסוימת עם צוות התמיכה.

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Could we try it except on Tuesdays?
dialogue.text_he: נוכל לנסות זאת מלבד בימי שלישי?

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: That is reasonable, provided that we review it.
dialogue.text_he: זה סביר בתנאי שנבחן זאת מחדש.

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: I can commit to a four-week trial period.
dialogue.text_he: אני יכול להתחייב לתקופת ניסיון של ארבעה שבועות.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: When should the trial be reviewed?
dialogue.text_he: מתי צריך לבחון את הניסוי?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: After four weeks, using response times and team feedback.
dialogue.text_he: אחרי ארבעה שבועות, באמצעות זמני מענה ומשוב מהצוות.

units.passage_en:
When Maya asked to change her working hours, her manager initially refused. The support team needed someone available until six, and Maya usually answered its technical questions. She felt disappointed, but instead of repeating her request, she asked which hours were genuinely difficult to cover.

The manager checked the previous month's messages. Most questions arrived between two and four; Tuesday was the exception because an overseas client held a late meeting. This evidence changed the discussion. Maya proposed starting at seven and leaving at four on four days, while keeping her usual Tuesday schedule. In return, she offered to prepare a short guide for common support problems.

They agreed on a four-week trial period. The arrangement would continue provided that urgent questions were answered and the guide reduced interruptions. They also agreed that Maya would not be expected to answer routine messages after leaving. At the review, the manager would consider response times, unfinished work and feedback from colleagues, rather than simply counting hours at a desk.

The compromise did not give either person everything they wanted. However, identifying the real constraint allowed them to meet halfway without quietly increasing Maya's workload. A flexible schedule became a practical experiment, not a personal favour.

passage_questions.question_en: What changed the discussion?
passage_questions.answer_en: Checking when support questions actually arrived.

passage_questions.question_en: Why was Tuesday different?
passage_questions.answer_en: An overseas client had a late meeting.

passage_questions.question_en: What did Maya offer in return?
passage_questions.answer_en: A guide to common support problems.

passage_questions.question_en: Who does They refer to in paragraph three?
passage_questions.answer_en: Maya and her manager.

passage_questions.question_he: למה קבעו גבול להודעות לאחר העבודה?
passage_questions.question_en: Why set a boundary on after-hours messages?
passage_questions.answer_en: To prevent the new schedule from increasing her workload invisibly.

passage_questions.question_he: איזה מדד מהטקסט מתאים לבחינת הניסוי?
passage_questions.question_en: Which stated measure could evaluate the trial?
passage_questions.answer_en: Response times, unfinished work or colleagues' feedback.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: אתם עובדים המבקשים לצאת מוקדם פעמיים בשבוע. המנהל צריך כיסוי ללקוחות. בררו אילוץ, הציעו תמורה והגדירו ניסוי ומדד הצלחה.
units.model_response_en: I understand that the team needs reliable coverage, so I would like to suggest a trial rather than a permanent change. Could I leave at four on Mondays and Thursdays, provided that another colleague covers the final hour? In return, I could take the early shift. After four weeks, we could review response times and decide whether the arrangement works for everyone.

language_focus.rule_he: בתנאי שני מציגים אפשרות מדומיינת בהווה או בעתיד באמצעות if ופועל בצורת עבר. בתוצאה משתמשים ב־would או could ואחריהם פועל בסיס. צורת העבר כאן מסמנת ריחוק מן המציאות, ולא בהכרח אירוע שקרה בעבר. could מדגישה אפשרות או יכולת, ואילו would מציגה תוצאה משוערת.
language_focus.example_en: If the team agreed, I would take the early shift.
language_focus.contrast_en: If the team agrees tomorrow, I will take the early shift.
language_focus.prompt_he: השלימו הצעה היפותטית בעזרת agree ו־would take: If the team ___, I ___ the early shift.
language_focus.answer_en: If the team agreed, I would take the early shift.
language_focus.feedback_he: אחרי if השתמשנו ב־agreed, ובתוצאה ב־would take. המשפט אינו טוען שהצוות כבר הסכים; הוא מציג אפשרות למשא ומתן.

units.input_readiness_he: לפני הטקסט בודקים מה המשתמש כבר מבין. תמיכות חדשות נחלקות לחבילות של עד 6 לפני המפגש או לטקסט קצר יותר. אין להניח שמילת תמיכה כבר ידועה, ואין לדחוס את כל רשימת הגלוסות לדקות המורה. זו קריאה מונחית; קריאה עצמאית דורשת בדיקת כיסוי אישית.
units.prerequisite_he: מיומנות תקשורת מן היחידה הקודמת, או מיון שמראה יכולת מקבילה. קריאה נבדקת בנפרד; אין חסימת שיחה בגלל פענוח.

units.goal_he: להביע התנגדות עניינית ולהכיר בנקודה של האחר
units.grammar_he: ויתור עם although/even if; הבחנה בין טענה לנימוק

dialogue.text_he: איזה חיסרון מדאיג אותך במיוחד?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Some residents rely on deliveries and accessible transport.
dialogue.text_he: חלק מהתושבים תלויים במשלוחים ובהסעות נגישות.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Could a temporary arrangement address that issue?
dialogue.text_he: האם הסדר זמני יכול לתת מענה לסוגיה?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Yes, if there is a clearly marked access route.
dialogue.text_he: כן, אם יהיה נתיב גישה מסומן בבירור.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What evidence would change your support?
dialogue.text_he: אילו ראיות ישנו את תמיכתכם?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Repeated access problems that the protected route cannot solve.
dialogue.text_he: בעיות גישה חוזרות שהנתיב המוגן אינו פותר.

units.passage_en:
At a neighbourhood meeting, residents discussed closing one street to cars for three hours every Sunday. Parents expected children to gain a safe place to play. Several shopkeepers hoped extra visitors would benefit their businesses. Others objected to the proposal because delivery vehicles and accessible taxis used the street.

The first ten minutes produced little common ground. Each group repeated its concern more loudly. Then a resident named Daniel suggested separating the aim from the arrangement. Almost everyone supported safer public space; they disagreed about how to create it.

Daniel acknowledged that even a temporary closure could cause real disruption. He asked whether a protected access route and a delivery window before ten would address the main objections. A shopkeeper raised another issue: visitors might leave rubbish behind. The committee added bins and a cleaning rota to the trial plan.

The residents approved four Sunday events, followed by a review. They would collect delivery delays, complaints and visitor numbers. On balance, the possible benefits justified testing the idea, but approval was not a promise to continue indefinitely. Daniel had not persuaded everyone to share his opinion. He had helped the group turn disagreement into questions that experience could answer.

passage_questions.question_en: What did most participants agree on?
passage_questions.answer_en: The aim of safer public space.

passage_questions.question_en: How long would each closure last?
passage_questions.answer_en: Three hours.

passage_questions.question_he: איזה חשש נוסף העלה בעל החנות?
passage_questions.question_en: What further issue did a shopkeeper raise?
passage_questions.answer_en: Visitors leaving rubbish behind.

passage_questions.question_he: למה מתייחס it במשפט how to create it?
passage_questions.question_en: What does it mean in how to create it?
passage_questions.answer_en: Safer public space.

passage_questions.question_he: למה אישור הניסוי אינו התחייבות להמשך?
passage_questions.question_en: Why did approval not guarantee continuation?
passage_questions.answer_en: The collected evidence might reveal unacceptable problems.

passage_questions.question_he: איזה נתון מהתוכנית בודק הפרעה לעסקים?
passage_questions.question_en: Which planned measure checks disruption to businesses?
passage_questions.answer_en: Delivery delays.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: שחקו תושב שתומך באזור משחק אך מתנגד לסגירה מלאה. הכירו בתועלת, תארו חשש והציעו ניסוי מדיד.
units.model_response_en: I acknowledge that children need safer places to play, and I would welcome an event that brings neighbours together. My concern is access for residents who cannot walk far. Even if the closure is temporary, that difficulty remains. Could we keep one protected route open? On balance, I would support a short trial if we record access problems and review them before continuing.

units.passage_en:
Dear Mr Green,

I am writing about the training materials due this afternoon. During our final check, we found that several diagrams contained outdated safety instructions. The files cannot be released until these have been corrected. I take responsibility for not identifying the issue earlier, and I understand the inconvenience this creates for your team.

We have prioritised the corrections and will send the complete materials by Friday at the latest. However, I realise that your introductory session is tomorrow. As an alternative, I have attached six checked pages that cover everything needed for that session. They can be printed or shared electronically. The remaining exercises are not required until next week.

Could you confirm whether this temporary version will meet tomorrow's needs? If a particular exercise is essential, please identify it before three today so that we can move it to the top of the list. I will keep you informed with a short update by the end of each working day, even if the revised deadline remains unchanged.

The attachment is clearly marked as an introductory pack to prevent it being confused with the final version. I am sorry for the disruption and appreciate the opportunity to put this right.

Kind regards,
Leah

passage_questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of the email?
passage_questions.answer_en: To explain a delay and offer a practical temporary solution.

passage_questions.question_en: What was wrong with the diagrams?
passage_questions.answer_en: They contained outdated safety instructions.

passage_questions.question_he: מה צריך הלקוח לעשות לפני שלוש?
passage_questions.question_en: What should the customer do before three?
passage_questions.answer_en: Identify any essential exercise that needs priority.

passage_questions.question_en: What does They refer to in paragraph two?
passage_questions.answer_en: The six checked pages.

passage_questions.question_en: Why was the attachment labelled an introductory pack?
passage_questions.answer_en: To avoid mistaking it for the complete final materials.

passage_questions.question_he: איזו התחייבות מבטיחה עדכון גם בלי שינוי?
passage_questions.question_en: Which commitment ensures updates without a change?
passage_questions.answer_en: A short update at the end of every working day.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: אתם ספקים שהמשלוח שלהם מתעכב יומיים. מסרו סיבה עניינית, קחו אחריות על חלקכם, הציעו חלופה והתחייבו לעדכון.
units.model_response_en: Thank you for explaining why tomorrow's delivery matters. Unfortunately, one part of the order failed our final inspection. I take responsibility for informing you later than I should have. We can deliver the checked items tomorrow and send the replacement by Thursday at the latest. Could you confirm whether a partial delivery would help? I will provide a further update by five today.

units.passage_en:
I was walking home when I noticed a bicycle lying beside the community centre. Its front wheel was bent, and the entrance door was open. A young man hurried past me carrying a large bag. Apparently, something serious had happened. I called the centre and told the receptionist that I thought I had witnessed a theft.

By the time she came outside, the young man had disappeared. She asked me to describe the sequence carefully. Had I seen him touch the bicycle? No. Had I seen him leave the building? I realised that I had only seen him on the pavement.

The receptionist then explained that the bicycle had been damaged the previous evening. Its owner had left it there while collecting a repair tool. The door was open because a volunteer was moving chairs. The young man turned out to be a music teacher carrying instruments to a lesson nearby.

I felt embarrassed, but she reassured me that calling with a concern was reasonable. The mistake was presenting my assumptions almost as facts. When I later described the incident to a friend, I separated what I had actually observed from what I had imagined. A reliable account, I learned, can begin with uncertainty.

passage_questions.question_en: What did the narrator learn?
passage_questions.answer_en: To separate observation from assumption.

passage_questions.question_en: When had the bicycle been damaged?
passage_questions.answer_en: The previous evening.

passage_questions.question_en: What was the man carrying?
passage_questions.answer_en: Musical instruments.

passage_questions.question_en: Who is she in the final paragraph?
passage_questions.answer_en: The receptionist.

passage_questions.question_he: למה הפקידה שאלה על רצף האירועים?
passage_questions.question_en: Why did the receptionist ask about the sequence?
passage_questions.answer_en: To establish what the narrator had actually witnessed.

passage_questions.question_he: איזו עובדה מהטקסט אפשר לדווח בלי השערה?
passage_questions.question_en: Which observation could be reported without speculation?
passage_questions.answer_en: The bicycle was lying by the centre with a bent front wheel.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: תארו לפקיד אירוע שראיתם חלק ממנו. המורה יבקש להבחין בין תצפית, השערה ומידע מאוחר. תקנו את הגרסה בלי להמציא פרטים.
units.model_response_en: When I arrived, the window was open and several papers were on the floor. I initially assumed somebody had entered the office. However, I did not actually see anyone inside. By the time the caretaker arrived, the wind had moved more papers. It turned out that a colleague had left the window open. My first description was therefore more certain than the evidence justified.

language_focus.rule_he: עבר מושלם נוצר באמצעות had וצורת past participle. משתמשים בו כדי להבהיר שאירוע אחד קדם לנקודת זמן אחרת בעבר. האירוע המאוחר יכול להופיע בעבר פשוט. אין צורך להעביר כל פועל בסיפור לעבר מושלם רק משום שהסיפור ישן.
language_focus.example_en: By the time I arrived, a colleague had left the window open.
language_focus.contrast_en: I arrived and then a colleague opened the window.
language_focus.prompt_he: עמית השאיר חלון פתוח לפני שהגעתם. השלימו בעזרת leave: By the time I arrived, a colleague ___ the window open.
language_focus.answer_en: By the time I arrived, a colleague had left the window open.
language_focus.feedback_he: had left מסמן את הפעולה המוקדמת, ו־arrived את נקודת הייחוס המאוחרת. משפט עם then היה יכול לתאר סדר אחר.

units.input_readiness_he: לפני הטקסט בודקים מה המשתמש כבר מבין. תמיכות חדשות נחלקות לחבילות של עד 6 לפני המפגש או לטקסט קצר יותר. אין להניח שמילת תמיכה כבר ידועה, ואין לדחוס את כל רשימת הגלוסות לדקות המורה. זו קריאה מונחית; קריאה עצמאית דורשת בדיקת כיסוי אישית.
units.prerequisite_he: מיומנות תקשורת מן היחידה הקודמת, או מיון שמראה יכולת מקבילה. קריאה נבדקת בנפרד; אין חסימת שיחה בגלל פענוח.

units.goal_he: לבדוק מקור ולנסח מסקנה מוגבלת

units.passage_en:
A message appeared in a local chat group: the town library was apparently closing permanently. The headline was followed by a photograph of locked doors and a quote from an angry visitor. Within an hour, dozens of people had shared it.

Nina decided to verify the claim before adding her own comment. She traced the photograph back to the library's official page. It was genuine, but it had been taken during repairs two years earlier. The quote was also real. However, the original article concerned reduced opening hours during a staff training day, not a permanent closure.

The library's latest update said that its heating system required maintenance. The building would close for three days, while online services continued. Nina posted the dated notice with a short explanation. She avoided calling everyone careless: the headline looked convincing, and several trusted neighbours had shared it.

One member argued that the photograph still proved the doors had been locked. Nina agreed, but explained that a true image can support a misleading story when its context is left out. She could confirm the temporary closure from the current notice. She could not promise that opening hours would never change in the future. Her correction was strongest where it stayed specific.

passage_questions.question_en: What made the message misleading?
passage_questions.answer_en: Real old material was presented as evidence of a current permanent closure.

passage_questions.question_en: When was the photograph taken?
passage_questions.answer_en: During repairs two years earlier.

passage_questions.question_he: לכמה זמן תיסגר הספרייה לפי העדכון?
passage_questions.question_en: How long would the library close according to the update?
passage_questions.answer_en: Three days.

passage_questions.question_en: What does It refer to in paragraph two?
passage_questions.answer_en: The photograph.

passage_questions.question_he: למה נינה לא העליבה את המשתפים?
passage_questions.question_en: Why did Nina avoid insulting those who shared it?
passage_questions.answer_en: The message looked convincing and trusted neighbours had spread it.

passage_questions.question_he: איזה מקור בטקסט מתאים לבדיקת המצב הנוכחי?
passage_questions.question_en: Which source best establishes the current situation?
passage_questions.answer_en: The library's latest dated maintenance notice.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: חבר מבקש שתפיצו הודעה על סגירת שירות. בקשו תאריך ומקור, הסבירו מה מאומת ומה עדיין לא, והציעו תיקון מכבד.
units.model_response_en: Before we share this, could we check the original notice and its date? The photograph may be genuine, but it does not establish why the doors were closed. According to the current update, the closure is temporary. I suggest sharing that notice instead, while explaining the difference politely. We should also leave room for further updates rather than claiming the situation can never change.
units.writing_prompt_he: כתבו תיקון בן 150–190 מילים להודעה מטעה: טענה מקורית, שני צעדי בדיקה, ממצא מאומת, מגבלת הידע וניסוח מכבד.

language_focus.example_en: The photograph might be old.
language_focus.contrast_en: The photograph must be old.

language_focus.feedback_he: might be מביעה אפשרות. must be הייתה מציגה ביטחון חזק יותר שלא התבקש כאן.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Which internet offer seems better value?
dialogue.text_he: איזו הצעת אינטרנט נראית משתלמת יותר?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: The cheaper price is attractive, but installation costs extra.
dialogue.text_he: המחיר הנמוך מושך, אבל ההתקנה בתשלום נוסף.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What other criteria matter to you?
dialogue.text_he: אילו קריטריונים נוספים חשובים לכם?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Reliable service and the freedom to cancel.
dialogue.text_he: שירות אמין ואפשרות לבטל.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Would you rule out the yearly subscription?
dialogue.text_he: האם תפסלו את המינוי השנתי?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Yes, because I may move before the contract ends.
dialogue.text_he: כן, כי ייתכן שאעבור דירה לפני סיום החוזה.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What would you confirm before signing?
dialogue.text_he: מה תוודאו לפני החתימה?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: The total six-month cost and exact cancellation conditions.
dialogue.text_he: את העלות הכוללת לשישה חודשים ואת תנאי הביטול המדויקים.

units.passage_en:
Omer and his flatmate needed an internet connection. Company A advertised a low monthly price, whereas Company B charged more but offered a shorter contract. At first, choosing A seemed obvious. Then they agreed on three criteria: the total cost over six months, reliability, and the ability to leave without a large fee.

Company A required a year's subscription and an installation payment upfront. Its advertised price applied only to the first three months. Company B included installation and allowed cancellation with a month's notice. Neither company promised a refund for every short interruption, although both offered technical support.

The flatmates also examined reviews. A few dramatic complaints were difficult to interpret, so they looked for repeated recent reports from their neighbourhood. Company B had fewer reports of evening connection problems. That did not guarantee reliable service, but it was more relevant than a national advertising award.

Because their rental agreement ended in six months, they ruled out the yearly commitment. Company B was not the cheapest option for someone staying several years. It suited their particular needs and reduced the risk of a cancellation charge. Weighing up alternatives had required more than comparing two large numbers on a sales page. Value for money depended on the situation.

passage_questions.question_en: Why did they choose Company B?
passage_questions.answer_en: Its short commitment and included installation suited their six-month rental.

passage_questions.question_he: לכמה זמן המחיר המפורסם של א׳ היה תקף?
passage_questions.question_en: How long did A's advertised price apply?
passage_questions.answer_en: Three months.

passage_questions.question_en: Which reviews did they examine?
passage_questions.answer_en: Repeated recent reports from their neighbourhood.

passage_questions.question_he: למי מתייחס their במשפט It suited their particular needs?
passage_questions.question_en: Who does their refer to in It suited their particular needs?
passage_questions.answer_en: Omer and his flatmate.

passage_questions.question_he: למה פרס פרסום ארצי היה פחות רלוונטי?
passage_questions.question_en: Why was a national advertising award less relevant?
passage_questions.answer_en: It did not directly show local connection reliability.

passage_questions.question_he: איזה קריטריון מהטקסט ישתנה אם יישארו שנים?
passage_questions.question_en: Which criterion might change if they stayed for years?
passage_questions.answer_en: The importance of short-term cancellation flexibility.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: השוו שתי הצעות למינוי: זולה עם התחייבות שנתית ויקרה עם ביטול חודשי. בררו את צרכי המורה והמליצו תוך ציון חיסרון.
units.model_response_en: I would weigh up the full cost rather than the introductory price alone. The yearly subscription could offer better value for someone who expects to stay, whereas the monthly option reduces risk if your plans change. Since your rental ends soon, flexibility seems particularly important. I would choose the monthly service, although I would first confirm whether installation and cancellation carry any additional charges.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What outcome would resolve your complaint?
dialogue.text_he: איזו תוצאה תפתור את התלונה שלכם?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: A replacement would help more than another discount.
dialogue.text_he: מוצר חלופי יעזור יותר מהנחה נוספת.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What can you show the service team?
dialogue.text_he: מה תוכלו להציג לצוות השירות?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: The receipt and our previous written agreement.
dialogue.text_he: את הקבלה ואת ההסכם הקודם בכתב.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What if they cannot decide today?
dialogue.text_he: מה אם לא יוכלו להחליט היום?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: I would ask for a reasonable timeframe in writing.
dialogue.text_he: אבקש פרק זמן סביר בכתב.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: How can you make follow-up easier?
dialogue.text_he: איך אפשר להקל על המעקב?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Keep the case number and the promised response time.
dialogue.text_he: לשמור את מספר הפנייה ואת זמן התגובה שהובטח.

units.passage_en:
When Rina's new washing machine stopped halfway through its first cycle, she called the retailer. A technician inspected it and ordered a replacement part. The repair was expected within five working days. Rina kept the receipt and asked the service agent to put that commitment in writing.

Eight working days later, no part had arrived. Rather than opening her next call with an angry accusation, Rina described the sequence and referred to the written message. She explained that paying for laundry elsewhere was becoming expensive. She wanted the issue resolved, not merely another general apology.

The agent offered a small discount on a future purchase. Rina acknowledged the goodwill but said it did not address the faulty machine. She asked whether a temporary machine or replacement could be arranged under the retailer's stated policy. The agent could not approve either option and agreed to escalate the case to a supervisor.

Before ending the call, Rina asked who would contact her and by when. She received a case number and a promised response the following afternoon. The conversation did not settle every question about her warranty. However, it produced a specific next step and a record against which she could check what happened next.

passage_questions.question_he: מה הפך את השיחה השנייה לממוקדת?
passage_questions.question_en: What made the second call focused?
passage_questions.answer_en: Rina stated the history, evidence, desired remedy and next-step deadline.

passage_questions.question_he: כמה ימי עבודה עברו לפני השיחה השנייה?
passage_questions.question_en: How many working days had passed?
passage_questions.answer_en: Eight.

passage_questions.question_en: What did the agent initially offer?
passage_questions.answer_en: A small discount on a future purchase.

passage_questions.question_en: What are either option?
passage_questions.answer_en: A temporary machine or a replacement.

passage_questions.question_he: למה ההנחה לא פתרה את הבעיה?
passage_questions.question_en: Why did the discount fail to solve the problem?
passage_questions.answer_en: It did not restore access to a working washing machine.

passage_questions.question_he: איזה פרט מהטקסט מאפשר מעקב בהמשך?
passage_questions.question_en: Which detail supports later follow-up?
passage_questions.answer_en: The case number and promised response time.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: המורה הוא נציג שירות. המוצר טרם תוקן במועד שסוכם. הציגו עובדות, הסבירו השלכה ובקשו פתרון וצעד מעקב מדויק.
units.model_response_en: I appreciate the offer, but a future discount does not resolve the problem I reported. As agreed in your email, the repair should have been completed last week. Could you inspect the available alternatives, including a temporary replacement? If you cannot authorise that, I would appreciate having the case escalated. Please confirm who will contact me and give me a specific response time in writing.
units.writing_prompt_he: כתבו תלונה בת 150–190 מילים: רצף אירועים, אסמכתה, השלכה, פתרון מבוקש וצעד הסלמה ענייני. אל תניחו זכויות משפטיות שלא נמסרו.

dialogue.text_en: No. His role and personal preferences also matter.
dialogue.text_he: לא. גם התפקיד וההעדפות האישיות שלו חשובים.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What expectation could you agree for future meetings?
dialogue.text_he: על איזו ציפייה אפשר להסכים לפגישות הבאות?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: We should identify major objections explicitly before confirming a plan.
dialogue.text_he: צריך לציין הסתייגויות מהותיות במפורש לפני אישור תוכנית.

units.passage_en:
During an international volunteer project, Amir presented an ambitious schedule. His colleague Sofia said it was interesting and asked whether the team had considered transport difficulties. Amir interpreted this as a small practical question. He later discovered that Sofia had serious doubts about the entire plan.

At first, Amir explained the misunderstanding as a difference between national cultures. A coordinator suggested a more careful approach. Cultural expectations can influence communication, but individuals also vary, and their roles affect what they feel able to say. Sofia was new to the project and had not wanted to embarrass its organiser in public.

Amir arranged a short private conversation. He acknowledged that he might have misunderstood her response and asked which parts of the schedule worried her. Sofia explained that two volunteers could not arrive before noon. They adjusted the first activity and agreed to identify major objections explicitly in future meetings.

Neither person had to adopt the other's entire communication style. Amir learned to check his understanding instead of treating polite interest as agreement. Sofia found a respectful way to express disagreement more directly. Their solution came from discussing a particular interaction, rather than turning either colleague into a representative of everyone from the same country.

passage_questions.question_en: What resolved the misunderstanding?
passage_questions.answer_en: A private clarification of specific concerns and future expectations.

passage_questions.question_he: למה שני מתנדבים לא יכלו להשתתף בפעילות הראשונה?
passage_questions.question_en: Why could two volunteers not join the first activity?
passage_questions.answer_en: They could not arrive before noon.

passage_questions.question_en: Why had Sofia expressed doubt indirectly?
passage_questions.answer_en: She was new and did not want to embarrass the organiser publicly.

passage_questions.question_he: למי מתייחס either colleague בפסקה האחרונה?
passage_questions.question_en: Who are either colleague?
passage_questions.answer_en: Amir and Sofia.

passage_questions.question_he: למה הסבר באמצעות לאום בלבד אינו מספיק?
passage_questions.question_en: Why is nationality alone an insufficient explanation?
passage_questions.answer_en: Personal variation and Sofia's new role also affected the interaction.

passage_questions.question_he: איזו שאלה מהסיפור עוזרת לבדוק הסכמה?
passage_questions.question_en: Which question helps check agreement?
passage_questions.answer_en: Asking which parts of the schedule worry the colleague.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: עמית הגיב להצעה בעמימות. בררו אם הוא מסכים, בקשו הסתייגות קונקרטית והימנעו מהכללה על הקבוצה שאליה הוא שייך.
units.model_response_en: I may have interpreted your earlier response too positively, so I would like to check my understanding. When you described the proposal as interesting, did you mean that you supported it, or that some parts needed more work? Please feel free to identify your main concern directly. I would rather clarify our expectations now than make an assumption that creates difficulties for the team later.
units.writing_prompt_he: כתבו רפלקציה בת 160–200 מילים על אי־הבנה בין עמיתים: שתי פרשנויות, שאלה מכבדת ופתרון שאינו מבוסס על הכללה תרבותית.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Where does the booking procedure slow down?
dialogue.text_he: באיזה מקום תהליך ההזמנה נעשה איטי?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Requests wait because nobody knows who should approve them.
dialogue.text_he: בקשות ממתינות כי לא ברור מי צריך לאשר אותן.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Would another form solve that bottleneck?
dialogue.text_he: האם טופס נוסף יפתור את צוואר הבקבוק?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: No. We need a named person responsible for each stage.
dialogue.text_he: לא. צריך אחראי מוגדר לכל שלב.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: How should users track their requests?
dialogue.text_he: איך המשתמשים צריכים לעקוב אחר הבקשות?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: They should receive a status update and reference number.
dialogue.text_he: עליהם לקבל עדכון מצב ומספר אסמכתה.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What would demonstrate an improvement?
dialogue.text_he: מה ידגים שיפור?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Fewer follow-up calls without more incorrect confirmations.
dialogue.text_he: פחות שיחות מעקב בלי יותר אישורים שגויים.

units.passage_en:
The community hall introduced an online booking form, expecting fewer calls to its office. Instead, callers continued asking whether their requests had been approved. Staff often entered the same information twice: once from the form and again when a caller spoke to a different employee.

A volunteer mapped the procedure. First, a request was submitted. Next, someone checked room availability. Then a coordinator approved unusual activities. Finally, the office confirmed the booking. The main bottleneck was not the form itself. Requests requiring approval were placed in a shared folder, but nobody was assigned to check it daily.

The revised procedure named one coordinator responsible for that stage. Each request received a reference number and an automatic message explaining its current status. Standard bookings could be confirmed as soon as availability was checked. Only exceptions, such as events requiring extra equipment, went to the coordinator.

The team also removed a duplicate question about contact details. After a month, it compared the time from submission to confirmation and counted follow-up calls. The aim was not to approve everything faster regardless of accuracy. It was to make responsibility clear and give users useful information while they waited. A simple change in ownership proved more valuable than adding another form.

passage_questions.question_en: What was the main cause of delay?
passage_questions.answer_en: Nobody was assigned to check requests awaiting approval daily.

passage_questions.question_he: מה קיבל כל מגיש בקשה בהליך החדש?
passage_questions.question_en: What did each applicant receive in the new procedure?
passage_questions.answer_en: A reference number and a message explaining status.

passage_questions.question_en: Which requests went to the coordinator?
passage_questions.answer_en: Exceptions such as events needing extra equipment.

passage_questions.question_he: למה מתייחס that stage בפסקה השלישית?
passage_questions.question_en: What does that stage refer to?
passage_questions.answer_en: Checking and approving requests that needed coordinator approval.

passage_questions.question_he: למה עצם הדיגיטציה לא הפחיתה שיחות?
passage_questions.question_en: Why did digitisation alone not reduce calls?
passage_questions.answer_en: Users still lacked confirmation and status information.

passage_questions.question_en: Which stated measure evaluates improvement?
passage_questions.answer_en: Time from submission to confirmation or the number of follow-up calls.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: הסבירו למתנדב חדש כיצד מאשרים בקשת חדר. לאחר מכן זהו עיכוב אפשרי והציעו שינוי שמגדיר אחריות ועדכון למשתמש.
units.model_response_en: First, the user submits a request and receives a reference number. The office then checks availability. Standard bookings are confirmed immediately, whereas unusual requirements are sent to the coordinator. To prevent a bottleneck, one person should be responsible for reviewing that queue every morning. If approval takes longer, the user should receive an update explaining what is missing and when to expect a decision.

language_focus.contrast_en: The coordinator checks requests before confirming bookings.

units.input_readiness_he: לפני הטקסט בודקים מה המשתמש כבר מבין. תמיכות חדשות נחלקות לחבילות של עד 6 לפני המפגש או לטקסט קצר יותר. אין להניח שמילת תמיכה כבר ידועה, ואין לדחוס את כל רשימת הגלוסות לדקות המורה. זו קריאה מונחית; קריאה עצמאית דורשת בדיקת כיסוי אישית.

units.passage_en:
The museum's volunteer team had twenty minutes to choose a date for its next open evening. Two experienced members quickly dominated the conversation. They discussed last year's event in detail while a new volunteer tried twice to speak. The chair noticed that the meeting was running out of time without reaching a decision.

She paused the discussion and summarised the two proposed dates. Then she invited the new volunteer, Lena, to contribute. Lena worked at a nearby college and knew that one date fell during examination week. This information had not appeared on the agenda, but it affected many potential visitors.

The chair asked each person to state one advantage and one concern about the remaining date. Participants took turns, and the team chose Thursday. Before moving on, she confirmed three action points: one volunteer would book the room, another would contact the college, and Lena would draft the announcement. Each task had an owner and a deadline.

Afterwards, a member suggested that inviting everyone to speak had slowed things down. The chair pointed out that a quick decision based on incomplete information might have required another meeting. Fair participation was not simply a courtesy. In this case, it helped the group avoid a predictable mistake and leave with a workable plan.

passage_questions.question_he: איך השילוב של לנה שיפר את ההחלטה?
passage_questions.question_en: How did including Lena improve the decision?
passage_questions.answer_en: She supplied examination-week information that affected attendance.

passage_questions.question_en: How much time did the team have?
passage_questions.answer_en: Twenty minutes.

passage_questions.question_he: מה הייתה משימת ההמשך של לנה?
passage_questions.question_en: What was Lena's action point?
passage_questions.answer_en: Drafting the announcement.

passage_questions.question_he: למי מתייחס she במשפט Then she invited?
passage_questions.question_en: Who does she refer to in Then she invited?
passage_questions.answer_en: The chair.

passage_questions.question_he: למה החלטה מהירה הייתה עלולה לעלות בזמן?
passage_questions.question_en: Why could a quick decision have cost time later?
passage_questions.answer_en: It might have needed reconsideration after missing information emerged.

passage_questions.question_en: Which meeting rule enables follow-up?
passage_questions.answer_en: Every task has an owner and a deadline.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: נהלו דיון קצר שבו שני עמיתים מתחרים על זמן דיבור. עצרו בכבוד, שלבו משתתף שקט וסיימו בהחלטה ובשתי משימות המשך.
units.model_response_en: Before we move on, could I check that I have understood both suggestions? Monday would be easier for staff, while Thursday may attract more visitors. Lena, we have not heard your perspective yet. Is there anything important we are missing? Once we decide, let us identify who will book the room and who will contact the college, with a deadline for each task.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Participation rose from twenty to thirty. What can we say?
dialogue.text_he: ההשתתפות עלתה מעשרים לשלושים. מה אפשר לומר?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Ten more people attended, which is a fifty-percent increase.
dialogue.text_he: הגיעו עוד עשרה אנשים, עלייה של חמישים אחוזים.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Does that prove the new poster caused the increase?
dialogue.text_he: האם זה מוכיח שהכרזה החדשה גרמה לעלייה?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: No. Other changes may account for the difference.
dialogue.text_he: לא. ייתכן ששינויים אחרים מסבירים את ההבדל.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What should a careful report include?
dialogue.text_he: מה דוח זהיר צריך לכלול?

dialogue.speaker: model

dialogue.text_he: את המספרים, המדגם ומגבלות המסקנה.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Which positive finding can you state confidently?
dialogue.text_he: איזה ממצא חיובי אפשר לציין בביטחון?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Average attendance rose, even though its cause remains uncertain.
dialogue.text_he: ההשתתפות הממוצעת עלתה, אף שהסיבה עדיין אינה ודאית.

units.passage_en:
The organiser of a free walking group wanted to know whether a new publicity poster had worked. Average attendance rose from twenty people in April to thirty in May. She prepared a headline announcing that the poster had increased participation by fifty percent.

Her colleague agreed that the numerical increase was fifty percent, but questioned the causal claim. May had also brought warmer weather, a later starting time and two public holidays. Any of those changes might account for part of the trend. Without a comparison group, they could not isolate the poster's effect.

They looked at a short survey completed by eighteen May participants. Six said they had seen the poster. That proportion suggested the poster had reached some attendees, but the sample was small and voluntary. People who ignored the survey might have heard about the walks in different ways. The replies were useful without necessarily being representative of everyone.

The final report stated the attendance figures and described the poster as one possible contributor. It recommended asking all new participants how they had heard about the group over the next two months. The organiser still had a positive result to share. She simply avoided turning a genuine increase into a stronger claim than the evidence supported.

passage_questions.question_en: Why was the original headline changed?
passage_questions.answer_en: It claimed the poster caused an increase that other changes might explain.

passage_questions.question_en: What was average attendance in May?
passage_questions.answer_en: Thirty people.

passage_questions.question_en: How many respondents had seen the poster?
passage_questions.answer_en: Six out of eighteen.

passage_questions.question_en: What does those changes refer to?
passage_questions.answer_en: Warmer weather, a later start and two public holidays.

passage_questions.question_he: למה סקר מרצון עשוי לא לייצג?
passage_questions.question_en: Why might a voluntary survey be unrepresentative?
passage_questions.answer_en: Respondents may differ from people who did not reply.

passage_questions.question_he: איזו טענה חיובית נתמכת בוודאות במספרים?
passage_questions.question_en: Which positive claim is directly supported by the figures?
passage_questions.answer_en: Average attendance increased from twenty to thirty.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: דווחו למנהל על עלייה בפעילות אחרי קמפיין. המורה ילחץ לטעון לסיבתיות. תארו נתון מדויק, הסבר חלופי ומידע נוסף נדרש.
units.model_response_en: Attendance increased from twenty to thirty participants, so the rise was fifty percent. That is encouraging, but it does not establish a causal link with the poster. The later start and warmer weather may also have contributed. Our voluntary survey suggests that some people saw the publicity. I would report those findings separately and collect more consistent information before drawing a stronger conclusion about effectiveness.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Would you cancel the outdoor concert because rain is possible?
dialogue.text_he: האם תבטלו את ההופעה בחוץ כי ייתכן גשם?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: I would check the likelihood and possible consequences first.
dialogue.text_he: קודם אבדוק את הסבירות ואת התוצאות האפשריות.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What backup plan would reduce the risk?
dialogue.text_he: איזו תוכנית גיבוי תפחית את הסיכון?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: We could reserve the smaller indoor hall.
dialogue.text_he: אפשר לשמור את האולם הפנימי הקטן יותר.

dialogue.speaker: model

dialogue.text_he: להודעה ברורה ולמידע על קיבולת והחזרים.

units.passage_en:
An outdoor concert was planned for Saturday afternoon. On Thursday, the forecast showed a possibility of heavy rain, but the timing remained uncertain. Cancelling immediately would disappoint performers and visitors. Waiting until the stage was fully assembled could waste money and create avoidable safety problems.

The organisers separated two questions: how likely was rain, and what would happen if it arrived? Light rain might reduce attendance, whereas strong wind could make the stage unsafe. They agreed that a safety warning would trigger cancellation regardless of ticket sales. They would continue to monitor official local forecasts rather than relying on a single screenshot.

As a backup plan, they provisionally reserved a smaller indoor hall. It could not hold every visitor, so they also prepared clear refund and notification procedures. Moving indoors was imperfect, but reserving the room was a reversible precaution until Friday evening.

The team chose a final decision time before the equipment was loaded. They would go ahead outdoors only if the conditions met their agreed safety requirements. This did not remove uncertainty or guarantee a successful concert. It allowed them to make an informed choice using the information available, protect essential requirements, and avoid postponing every difficult decision until action became expensive or impossible.

passage_questions.question_he: מה אפשר לארגון לנהל את אי־הוודאות?
passage_questions.question_en: What enabled the team to manage uncertainty?
passage_questions.answer_en: Separate safety thresholds, monitoring, a backup and a decision deadline.

passage_questions.question_he: איזה תנאי יביא לביטול ללא תלות במכירות?
passage_questions.question_en: What would trigger cancellation regardless of sales?
passage_questions.answer_en: A safety warning.

passage_questions.question_en: What was the backup hall's limitation?
passage_questions.answer_en: It could not hold every visitor.

passage_questions.question_he: למה מתייחס It במשפט It allowed them?
passage_questions.question_en: What does It refer to in It allowed them?
passage_questions.answer_en: The agreed decision-making approach.

passage_questions.question_he: למה ההחלטה נקבעה לפני העמסת ציוד?
passage_questions.question_en: Why decide before loading equipment?
passage_questions.answer_en: To avoid expensive commitments before conditions were assessed.

passage_questions.question_en: Which precaution was reversible?
passage_questions.answer_en: The provisional indoor hall reservation until Friday evening.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: אתם מארגנים טיול שתלוי במזג האוויר. הפרידו אי־נוחות מסיכון, הציעו גיבוי וקבעו מתי ועל בסיס מה תחליטו.
units.model_response_en: I would not treat every chance of rain as a reason to cancel, but we need clear safety limits. Let us monitor the official forecast and reserve an indoor alternative if possible. We should decide before visitors begin travelling. If a safety warning is issued, we will postpone regardless of inconvenience. Otherwise, we can weigh up attendance, accessibility and the limitations of our backup plan together.

units.passage_en:
After a practice presentation, Ben asked his colleague Ella for feedback. Her first response was that he needed to be more confident. Ben became defensive because he had prepared carefully and did not know what to change. Ella realised that she had described an impression rather than an action.

She tried again. She praised the opening example because it made the customer problem concrete. Then she identified a specific difficulty: Ben had moved to the next slide while still explaining the previous chart. Several listeners had stopped taking notes because they could not follow which figures he meant.

Ben explained that he had been trying to finish within the time limit. Ella acknowledged his intention, while distinguishing it from the impact on the audience. Together, they came up with a practical revision. Ben would remove one less important chart and introduce each remaining chart before discussing its figures.

At the second practice, Ella watched for the agreed change rather than searching for every possible fault. Ben completed the presentation on time, and the sequence was easier to follow. He had taken the feedback on board because it offered an achievable next step. Constructive feedback had become a small shared experiment, rather than a judgement about his personality.

passage_questions.question_he: למה המשוב השני היה שימושי יותר?
passage_questions.question_en: Why was the second feedback more useful?
passage_questions.answer_en: It identified a specific behaviour, its impact and a feasible change.

passage_questions.question_en: Which part was praised?
passage_questions.answer_en: The opening example.

passage_questions.question_en: What revision did they agree on?
passage_questions.answer_en: Remove one less important chart and introduce the others before explaining figures.

passage_questions.question_he: למה מתייחס it במשפט distinguishing it from the impact?
passage_questions.question_en: What does it refer to in distinguishing it from the impact?
passage_questions.answer_en: Ben's intention to finish within the time limit.

passage_questions.question_he: למה הביטוי יותר בטוח לא עזר?
passage_questions.question_en: Why did more confident not help?
passage_questions.answer_en: It did not identify an observable action Ben could change.

passage_questions.question_en: What did Ella check in the second practice?
passage_questions.answer_en: Whether the agreed presentation change improved the sequence.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: תנו לעמית משוב על הסבר שלא היה ברור. הציגו חוזקה, התנהגות ספציפית, השפעה ושינוי אחד. הגיבו להסבר שלו בכבוד.
units.model_response_en: The example at the beginning was a real strength because it helped me understand the problem. I became confused when the next slide appeared before you had finished explaining the chart. I understand that you were watching the time. Next time, could you remove one less important example and keep the relevant slide visible? We could then check whether the explanation becomes easier to follow.

language_focus.rule_he: כדי לבחון חלופה שלא התרחשה בעבר, אפשר להשתמש ב־if had ובצורת past participle. בתוצאה המדומיינת משתמשים ב־would have ובצורת past participle. כך מתמקדים בפעולה אפשרית ובתוצאה שלה במקום להגדיר אדם באמצעות תכונה קבועה. המשמעות היא חלופה משוערת, לא הוכחה למה שהיה קורה.
language_focus.example_en: If we had sent a reminder, the deadline would have been clearer.
language_focus.contrast_en: If we send a reminder, the deadline will be clearer.
language_focus.prompt_he: הפגישה כבר הסתיימה ולא נשלחה תזכורת. השלימו חלופה לעבר בעזרת send ו־be: If we ___ a reminder, the deadline ___ clearer.
language_focus.answer_en: If we had sent a reminder, the deadline would have been clearer.
language_focus.feedback_he: had sent מתאר תנאי שלא התקיים בעבר. would have been מתאר את התוצאה המדומיינת בעבר.

units.input_readiness_he: לפני הטקסט בודקים מה המשתמש כבר מבין. תמיכות חדשות נחלקות לחבילות של עד 6 לפני המפגש או לטקסט קצר יותר. אין להניח שמילת תמיכה כבר ידועה, ואין לדחוס את כל רשימת הגלוסות לדקות המורה. זו קריאה מונחית; קריאה עצמאית דורשת בדיקת כיסוי אישית.
units.prerequisite_he: מיומנות תקשורת מן היחידה הקודמת, או מיון שמראה יכולת מקבילה. קריאה נבדקת בנפרד; אין חסימת שיחה בגלל פענוח.

units.goal_he: להציב יעד התנהגותי ולתקן תוכנית לפי ביצוע

dialogue.text_en: I planned long sessions that rarely fitted my evenings.
dialogue.text_he: תכננתי מפגשים ארוכים שכמעט לא התאימו לערבים שלי.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What would a manageable routine look like?
dialogue.text_he: איך תיראה שגרה בת־ביצוע?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Three short sessions and one practical task each week.
dialogue.text_he: שלושה מפגשים קצרים ומשימה מעשית אחת בכל שבוע.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: How will you judge progress?
dialogue.text_he: איך תשפטו את ההתקדמות?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: By what I can do independently, not just time spent.
dialogue.text_he: לפי מה שאוכל לעשות בעצמי, ולא רק זמן שהשקעתי.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What will you do after a demanding week?
dialogue.text_he: מה תעשו בשבוע עמוס?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Shorten a practice session and return to the planned routine.
dialogue.text_he: נקצר מפגש תרגול ונחזור לשגרה המתוכננת.

units.passage_en:
When Dana decided to learn photography, she bought a long online course and planned to study for two hours every evening. For four days she followed the plan. Then work became busy, she missed a session, and the unfinished lessons began to feel like a growing debt.

A friend suggested breaking the goal down. Instead of completing the course quickly, Dana would learn to take a clear indoor portrait without using the camera's automatic mode. She scheduled three twenty-minute practice sessions a week and one short photo task at the weekend. Each session focused on one setting rather than several unfamiliar techniques.

Dana kept examples from her attempts and wrote a sentence about what she would adjust next time. A blurred photograph became information about shutter speed, not proof that she lacked talent. When a week was unusually demanding, she completed a shorter session instead of abandoning the routine entirely.

After a month, she compared new portraits with her first attempts. Some problems remained, especially in poor light, but she could explain and control choices that had previously been accidental. The new routine did not guarantee rapid progress. It made practice manageable and gave her a concrete way to notice improvement, reflect on setbacks and decide what to learn next.

passage_questions.question_en: What changed in Dana's plan?
passage_questions.answer_en: She replaced ambitious course completion with a specific skill and manageable practice.

passage_questions.question_en: How many short sessions were planned weekly?
passage_questions.answer_en: Three twenty-minute sessions.

passage_questions.question_en: What did a blurred photograph tell her?
passage_questions.answer_en: She needed to adjust shutter speed.

passage_questions.question_he: למה מתייחס the goal בפסקה השנייה?
passage_questions.question_en: What goal is being broken down in paragraph two?
passage_questions.answer_en: Learning photography, narrowed to a clear indoor portrait without automatic mode.

passage_questions.question_en: Why did she keep earlier attempts?
passage_questions.answer_en: To compare performance and identify concrete improvement.

passage_questions.question_en: What adjustment did she make in a demanding week?
passage_questions.answer_en: A shorter session instead of abandoning the routine.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: אתם לומדים מיומנות חדשה ויש לכם מעט זמן. הציעו למורה שגרה, יעד ביצוע, דרך לראות שיפור ותוכנית לשבוע עמוס.
units.model_response_en: My earlier plan depended on having two free hours every evening, which was unrealistic. I would now choose one practical outcome and break it down into smaller skills. Three short practice sessions would be manageable, with a task at the weekend to check transfer. I would keep examples of my work and adjust the plan when difficulties repeat, rather than treating a missed session as failure.

units.passage_en:
A neighbourhood repair café offered volunteers' help with broken household items. Its first poster announced that everyone could save money and protect the planet. The message sounded positive, but few residents signed up. The organisers initially assumed that people did not care enough about waste.

They spoke to several non-participants. Some worried that repairs would take the whole afternoon. Others did not know which items were accepted or whether they would be charged if a volunteer could not fix something. The main barrier was uncertainty about the experience, not necessarily disagreement with its purpose.

The revised campaign used a photograph of the actual venue and a simple explanation: book a free twenty-minute assessment, bring one small household item, and receive advice even if repair is not possible. It clearly excluded gas appliances and other items the volunteers could not safely handle. The call to action linked directly to the booking page.

To test the message, the team alternated the two posters on comparable local noticeboards and asked new visitors where they had heard about the café. This small test could not establish a universal marketing rule. However, it helped the organisers replace a broad promise with credible information that addressed their audience's practical concerns without overstating what volunteers could deliver.

passage_questions.question_en: What was missing from the first message?
passage_questions.answer_en: Practical information addressing participation barriers.

passage_questions.question_en: How long was the free assessment?
passage_questions.answer_en: Twenty minutes.

passage_questions.question_en: Which type of appliance was excluded?
passage_questions.answer_en: Gas appliances.

passage_questions.question_en: What does its purpose refer to?
passage_questions.answer_en: The repair café's aim of reducing waste and helping residents.

passage_questions.question_he: למה עצה גם ללא תיקון עשויה לעודד הרשמה?
passage_questions.question_en: Why might advice without guaranteed repair encourage registration?
passage_questions.answer_en: It makes the value and limits of the visit clearer.

passage_questions.question_he: איזו הבטחה בטקסט אפשר לתת בלי הגזמה?
passage_questions.question_en: Which promise can be made without overstatement?
passage_questions.answer_en: A free assessment and advice, rather than guaranteed repair.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: שכנעו תושב להירשם ליוזמה קהילתית. בררו חשש, הציעו ערך אמיתי וצעד ברור, וציינו מגבלה בלי להמציא הבטחות.
units.model_response_en: If you are unsure whether your item can be repaired, you can book a free assessment before committing to anything else. A volunteer will examine one small household item and explain the available options. We cannot promise a successful repair, but you will receive practical advice. The session lasts twenty minutes, and the booking page clearly lists the items we can safely accept at the café.
units.writing_prompt_he: כתבו מסר קמפיין והסבר לבחירותיכם, יחד 160–200 מילים: קהל, חסם, הבטחה אמינה, הנעה לפעולה ודרך בדיקה.

dialogue.text_en: How can you bring up the noise problem?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: I would describe when it affects me and ask for an agreement.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What boundary would be reasonable?

units.passage_en:
Three flatmates shared a small apartment but worked different hours. One often returned late and cooked while listening to music. Another left early and used the blender before seven. The third quietly cleaned the kitchen because dirty dishes made it difficult to prepare breakfast. None of them had discussed what considerate behaviour meant in their household.

After an argument about noise, they met at a calm time. Each described a specific difficulty rather than accusing the others of being selfish. They discovered that the problem involved conflicting routines as much as unwillingness to help.

Their agreement set quiet hours on work nights and asked for advance notice of occasional guests. Each person would clean cooking equipment immediately, while other kitchen cleaning rotated weekly. They also agreed to split the cost of basic cleaning supplies. A shared note listed responsibilities, but it was not used to record every minor mistake.

Two weeks later, they reviewed the arrangement. The early worker moved the blender away from a bedroom wall, and the late worker used headphones. The kitchen rota needed a different day because one flatmate was usually away on Sundays. The agreement worked because it was specific enough to guide behaviour and flexible enough to adjust when a reasonable boundary created a new problem.

passage_questions.question_en: Why did the agreement work?
passage_questions.answer_en: It combined specific mutual responsibilities with review and adjustment.

passage_questions.question_en: What did the early worker change?
passage_questions.answer_en: Moved the blender away from a bedroom wall.

passage_questions.question_en: Which cost did the flatmates share?
passage_questions.answer_en: Basic cleaning supplies.

passage_questions.question_he: למי מתייחס Each person בפסקה השלישית?
passage_questions.question_en: Who does Each person refer to?
passage_questions.answer_en: Each of the three flatmates.

passage_questions.question_he: למה לא רשמו כל טעות קטנה?
passage_questions.question_en: Why avoid recording every minor mistake?
passage_questions.answer_en: The note was meant to guide cooperation rather than become a punishment record.

passage_questions.question_he: איזה פרט הצדיק שינוי ביום התורנות?
passage_questions.question_en: Which fact justified changing the rota day?
passage_questions.answer_en: One flatmate was usually away on Sundays.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: שוחחו עם שותף על רעש ומטבח. הסבירו צורך אישי, שאלו על השגרה שלו וסכמו כלל הדדי וחריג עם הודעה מראש.
units.model_response_en: I would like us to agree on quiet hours because the noise is affecting my sleep before work. I realise that you often return home late, and you still need to cook. Could we use headphones after eleven and avoid noisy appliances near the bedrooms? I will follow the same rule early in the morning. We can review the arrangement after two weeks and adjust any practical difficulties.
units.writing_prompt_he: כתבו הסכם שותפים בן 150–190 מילים: שני גבולות, חלוקת אחריות, טיפול בחריג, הוצאה משותפת ומועד בדיקה.

units.passage_en:
On a group trip, a station announcement explained that engineering work had cancelled the next train. Some travellers understood only the word cancelled. One began looking for a taxi, while another worried that their tickets were no longer valid. Sara offered to check the details before anyone left the group.

A staff member explained that a replacement bus would depart from the station's north entrance in twenty minutes. Existing tickets would be accepted. The bus would take passengers to a nearby station, where they could catch the next train. Staff could arrange assistance for travellers who found the walking route difficult, but they needed to know immediately.

Sara passed on the information in short steps. First, the group would stay together and make its way to the north entrance. Their tickets remained valid. Anyone needing assistance should tell her now so she could contact staff. They would allow extra time for the connection instead of expecting the original arrival time.

She asked a traveller to repeat the first step and checked the entrance sign with another. Sara did not translate every sentence of the announcement. She selected the information needed for action and verified uncertain details. By distinguishing confirmed instructions from guesses, she helped the group respond calmly to the disruption.

passage_questions.question_he: מה הייתה פעולת התיווך של שרה?
passage_questions.question_en: What did Sara's mediation involve?
passage_questions.answer_en: Checking key information and passing on actionable steps clearly.

passage_questions.question_en: Which entrance would the bus leave from?
passage_questions.answer_en: The north entrance.

passage_questions.question_en: Did passengers need new tickets?
passage_questions.answer_en: No, existing tickets would be accepted.

passage_questions.question_he: למי מתייחס they במשפט they needed to know immediately?
passage_questions.question_en: Who does they refer to in they needed to know immediately?
passage_questions.answer_en: Station staff.

passage_questions.question_he: למה שרה לא תרגמה כל משפט?
passage_questions.question_en: Why did Sara not translate every sentence?
passage_questions.answer_en: The group needed the essential information for immediate action.

passage_questions.question_he: איזו בדיקה בטקסט מוודאת הבנת צעד הבא?
passage_questions.question_en: Which check established understanding of the next step?
passage_questions.answer_en: Asking a traveller to repeat the first step.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: המורה מוסר הודעה על החלפת רכבת באוטובוס. בררו שלושה פרטים ואז הסבירו אותם לקבוצה בשפה פשוטה, בלי להוסיף מידע שלא אושר.
units.model_response_en: I checked with the station staff. Our train is cancelled, but a replacement bus leaves from the north entrance in twenty minutes. Our existing tickets remain valid, so please do not buy new ones yet. Let us keep together and follow the signs. If anyone needs help with the walk, tell me now. Could somebody repeat where we are going first, so we can check everyone understood?

units.goal_he: לפתח טיעון עם הסתייגות ולנסח מסקנה מותנית
units.grammar_he: מבנה טיעון; concessive clauses; should לעומת might

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Should the sports centre accept bookings only through an app?
dialogue.text_he: האם מרכז הספורט צריך לקבל הזמנות רק באפליקציה?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: The app is convenient, but exclusive access creates a trade-off.
dialogue.text_he: האפליקציה נוחה, אבל גישה בלעדית יוצרת מחיר לבחירה.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: Who could lose access?
dialogue.text_he: מי עלול לאבד גישה?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: People without a suitable phone or reliable connection.
dialogue.text_he: אנשים ללא טלפון מתאים או חיבור אמין.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What balanced approach would you propose?
dialogue.text_he: איזו גישה מאוזנת תציעו?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Keep the app and offer a phone booking alternative.
dialogue.text_he: להשאיר את האפליקציה ולהציע הזמנה חלופית בטלפון.

dialogue.speaker: teacher
dialogue.text_en: What difficulty does your alternative create?
dialogue.text_he: איזה קושי יוצרת החלופה שלכם?

dialogue.speaker: model
dialogue.text_en: Staff must coordinate booking routes to prevent double bookings.
dialogue.text_he: הצוות חייב לתאם בין ערוצי ההזמנה כדי למנוע הזמנות כפולות.

units.passage_en:
The local sports centre replaced its paper booking system with an app. Members could see available classes immediately, cancel places and receive reminders. Staff spent less time answering routine calls. In principle, the change seemed to benefit almost everyone.

However, several regular members struggled to book. One did not own a suitable phone, while another shared a device with family members. A third could use the app but objected to providing information unrelated to booking. The problem was not simply resistance to technology. A convenient system had become the only route to a public service.

At a review meeting, staff considered returning entirely to paper. Members suggested a different solution: retain the efficient app while allowing a limited number of telephone and desk bookings. They also asked the centre to explain which personal details were necessary and whether optional notifications could be switched off.

The final arrangement involved a trade-off. Staff still handled some calls, and maintaining two routes required care to avoid double bookings. Nevertheless, the centre kept most of the convenience while reducing barriers to access. The lesson was not that every digital change should be rejected. It was that benefits should be assessed alongside who bears the costs, and that practical safeguards can sometimes resolve a conflict better than choosing either extreme.

passage_questions.question_en: What balanced solution was chosen?
passage_questions.answer_en: Keep the app while offering phone and desk bookings and clarifying data needs.

passage_questions.question_he: מה הפחית את עבודת הצוות בתחילה?
passage_questions.question_en: What initially reduced staff work?
passage_questions.answer_en: Immediate booking information, cancellations and reminders through the app.

passage_questions.question_en: What did the third member object to providing?
passage_questions.answer_en: Information unrelated to booking.

passage_questions.question_he: למה מתייחס the change בפסקה הראשונה?
passage_questions.question_en: What does the change refer to in paragraph one?
passage_questions.answer_en: Replacing paper booking with an app.

passage_questions.question_he: למה התנגדות אינה בהכרח פחד מטכנולוגיה?
passage_questions.question_en: Why is the objection not necessarily fear of technology?
passage_questions.answer_en: Members faced practical device barriers or questioned unnecessary data collection.

passage_questions.question_he: איזה סיכון תפעולי נוצר משתי דרכי הזמנה?
passage_questions.question_en: What operational risk did two booking routes create?
passage_questions.answer_en: Double bookings.

units.roleplay_prompt_he: דונו עם מנהל שרוצה לבטל שירות אנושי לטובת אפליקציה. הכירו בתועלת, הציגו שתי עלויות והציעו הגנה מעשית עם חיסרון משלה.
units.model_response_en: I support the app because it makes booking faster and allows staff to focus on more complicated requests. Nevertheless, convenience should not become a barrier for people without a suitable device. I would keep telephone bookings as an alternative and collect only information needed for the service. This means some additional administration, but those costs may be justified by fairer access and greater trust among members.
units.writing_prompt_he: כתבו טיעון בן 180–220 מילים: עמדה, תועלת, קבוצת משתמשים שנפגעת, טיעון נגדי ומסקנה עם תנאים.
